---
title: "Resume a scan"
description: "Restore accepted captures when a customer returns to your flow."
---

Save the scan ID with your application record. When the customer returns, reuse that scan and request a fresh [initialization token](/external/api/create-token).

Initialize a new SDK instance with the fresh token and the same scan’s configuration. The SDK restores the scan’s state. Call `start()` when it enters `Phase.READY` to capture any remaining side.

| Saved progress | What happens on resume |
| --- | --- |
| No accepted capture | The SDK restores the saved selection, or requests any missing selection. |
| At least one accepted side | The SDK requests the remaining capture. `state.resumable` is `true`. |
| All required captures accepted | The SDK reports processing progress. |
| Processing complete | The SDK reports completion. Retrieve the result from your backend. |

## Cancel and restart in the same page

Call `stop()` to cancel capture and release the camera. Call `start()` to continue using the same instance. Call `destroy()` when leaving the capture page; a destroyed instance cannot restart.

To submit a different document after evidence has been accepted, create a new scan. See [Errors](/external/recovery) for correcting a selection before that point.
